cohort: 12,198 women who gave birth at MacKay Memorial Hospital in Taiwan between 2014 and 2018
finding: Low educational level, unmarried status, unemployment, Cesarean section, unplanned pregnancy, preterm delivery, non-intention of breastfeeding, and low 5-minute Apgar score were identified as predictors for postpartum depression.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with increased odds of developing PPD (OR=1.7, 95% CI 1.5-1.93).
